info.title: Stackurity API
info.description: The Stackurity REST API. Requests and responses are JSON. Every operation names the role it needs (x-stackurity-role); roles apply organisation-wide or through project grants (see docs/api.md, "Projects and access"). Send X-Stackurity-Project: <id> (or project_id) to limit project-scoped reads to one project. Operations marked x-stackurity-edition: ee exist in the licensed build only. Response bodies are described in docs/api.md; this document lists every operation, its parameters and its authentication. AI assistants use /mcp instead (docs/ai-assistants.md).

get.summary: Vulnerability and end-of-life findings, SOS, priority, known-exploited and most severe first
get.description:
Vulnerability and end-of-life findings, SOS, priority, known-exploited and most severe first. `new_within=N` keeps findings first seen in the last N days, `resolved_within=N` those resolved in the last N days (with `status=resolved`), `resolution_kind` (comma-separated: remediated, removed, superseded, advisory_withdrawn, advisory_changed, not_evaluated, other) those closed for that reason, and `sort=asset` orders by asset name first. `epss_min` (0 to 1) keeps findings one of whose CVEs has at least that EPSS. Each finding carries `epss`, `epss_percentile`, `epss_date`, `epss_model_version` and `epss_cve` (null without a score): the highest EPSS among the finding's CVEs (its key, and the CVEs its advisories list as aliases or upstream ids), and the CVE it is for. Also filters by `priority`, `state`, `sos`, `overdue`, assignee (`assignee_user`, `assignee_team`, `assignee=none`), `fix_group`, `incident_id` and `second_check`; paged with `limit` and `offset`

Role: viewer

parameters.name: epss_min
parameters.description: Vulnerability findings whose CVE has a FIRST EPSS of at least this probability, 0 to 1 (0.1 is 10%)

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: active, new, acknowledged, in_progress, suppressed, risk_accepted or regressed

post.summary: Open the bulk email preference page from a signed link
post.description:
`{"token"}` from a bulk email's link (`/email/preferences#...`). Changes nothing. Answers `kind` (`preferences` or `unsubscribe`), `email` (partly hidden), `categories` and `locked`; an unsubscribe link answers its `category` only. 410 `link_expired` or `link_invalid`

Role: none (rate limited)

post.summary: Change bulk email preferences from a signed link
post.description:
`{"token", "marketing"?, "vulnerability_news"?}`. An unsubscribe link can only set its own category to `false` (403 otherwise); an Email preferences link can change both. Mail clients use the one-click address in the `List-Unsubscribe` header (RFC 8058), `POST /email/preferences/one-click?t=...`, outside /api/v1

Role: none (rate limited)

post.summary: Import a VEX document
post.description:
The body is an OpenVEX or CycloneDX VEX document (or a CycloneDX BOM with VEX embedded), plain or as a DSSE envelope or Sigstore bundle; at most 16 MiB. `source_id` names a source, `asset_id` or `project_id` limits matching, `filename` is recorded. not_affected statements wait in the approval inbox unless the source is trusted to apply and every pin held. Answers what matched, what waits, what applied and why statements did not match

Role: engineer+

get.summary: Imported VEX documents
get.description:
Imported documents, newest first, paged

Role: viewer

get.summary: One imported VEX document
get.description:
One document

Role: viewer

get.summary: A VEX document's statements
get.description:
Statements with what each matched, its problems and its approval request. `outcome`: matched, unmatched or pending

Role: viewer

post.summary: Approve or decline a VEX document's pending statements
post.description:
`{"decision": "approve" | "decline", "note": "..."}` for every pending request of the document; organisation-wide security or admin only

Role: security

get.summary: VEX sources
get.description:
Sources and how far each is trusted

Role: security

post.summary: Add a VEX source
post.description:
`name`, `auto_apply`, `token_id`, `public_key` (PEM). auto_apply needs a public key or a token

Role: admin

patch.description:
Changes the fields sent; `token_id: 0` and `public_key: ""` remove a pin

Role: admin

delete.description:
Its documents keep its name

Role: admin

get.summary: Export decisions as VEX
get.description:
False positives, mitigations and imported statements about open issues. `format`: openvex (default) or cyclonedx; `asset_id` or `project_id` narrows it

Role: viewer
